name: Wasabi Preview Mobile
subtitle: Your desktop Wasabi Wallet, in your pocket.
localizedDescription:
A companion for Wasabi Wallet running on your own computer. See your balance, privacy progress and transactions, receive with a QR code, and send by scanning QR codes or pasting BIP 321 payment links.

The app holds no keys: your computer's Wasabi does the signing, and every payment asks for Face ID first. It connects only through your own Tailscale network or a client-authorized Tor onion service, with Tor (Arti) built into the app.

Privacy without the jargon: choose lower fees or more privacy when you send or receive, and Wasabi's coinjoin (a non-custodial collaborative transaction) makes new coins private. Discreet mode frosts amounts and addresses, and a Black theme keeps OLED pixels off.

Requires Wasabi Wallet on your computer with its JSON-RPC server enabled.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Scans bitcoin QR codes to fill in the address and amount.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Connects to Wasabi Wallet running on your computer.
